name: Bot designer
tagline: Draft tight bot personas, wire webhook UIs, run fleet checkups
description: A workbench for building bots rather than using them. Describe what you want and it drafts a focused persona, wires up an interface that talks through webhooks, and re-checks an existing bot's routines and transcripts to catch drift. The maker calls it an early version, so expect rough edges.
author: _kvnloo
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
